elements.name: q_1
elements.title: What media types does 1.2.8 cover?
choices: Prerecorded synchronized media and prerecorded video-only media

elements.name: q_2
elements.title: Why can a speech-only transcript be incomplete?
choices: It may omit meaningful visual actions and results

elements.name: q_3
elements.title: What about interactive opportunities in the original media?
choices: Provide a means to achieve equivalent interaction as required by the definition

answer_key.q_1: Prerecorded synchronized media and prerecorded video-only media
answer_key.q_2: It may omit meaningful visual actions and results
answer_key.q_3: Provide a means to achieve equivalent interaction as required by the definition

explanations.q_1: The criterion explicitly covers synchronized and video-only prerecorded media.
explanations.q_2: The alternative must convey relevant visual and audio information.
explanations.q_3: The definition addresses opportunities to achieve the same interaction.
